notes.title: SynthVR 1.1
notes.notes:
[b]Features:[/b]
- Improved "onboarding experience" with 5 interactive tutorials
- OpenXR support
- Optimized rending performance
- Faster patch loading

[b]New modules:[/b]
- Scope, a handy oscilloscope for visualizing signal
- Shape, a DJ-style multimode filter for fast tonal shaping

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
- Fixes issue where Just Drums would recall the wrong sample on load
- Prevents patches from autosaving while they are loading

notes.title: SynthVR v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey synthers, here is a small update that could have a big impact - It switches SynthVR to a different scripting backend which is more performant and DSP-friendly. Especially Quest users will notice a significant performance improvement, being able to run larger patches without issues.

[b]What's new?[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance optimizations for PCVR
[*] Performance optimizations for Oculus Quest
[*] Ensures Quest build compliance with Oculus App Lab requirements
[/list]

notes.title: SynthVR 1.0 is out now!
notes.notes:
We did it - SynthVR 1.0 is out now!

SynthVR comes packed with great modules, patch sharing and advanced audio recording features. I'm very proud that we were able to pull this off.

I am so grateful to everyone in our online community of VR synth nerds - They have played an integral part in shaping SynthVR into a music production app that is fun, exciting and powerful.

As SynthVR releases to the general public, I hope it can be among this first wave of VR apps to become serious creative tools for sound artists.

Thanks for all your support and happy synthing!

Get it now for PCVR:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1517890/SynthVR
